message:
Let me check the afl directory contents and see if there's a built fuzzer binary.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/afl/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---FIND BIN---"; find /workspace/repo-vul -type f -executable 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.sh\|\.py\|\.pl" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
